content: @phosphor-icons/react is at v2.1.10 (npm view confirmed), weekly downloads ~2.9M, repo github.com/phosphor-icons/react, not deprecated, no postinstall script. Supports tree-shaking when icons are imported individually (named imports from the package root); importing the whole icon barrel or importing during dev can eagerly transpile 9000+ modules and slow dev builds -- import per-icon-path or rely on Next.js 13+ optimizePackageImports in next.config to auto-scope imports. Tree-shaken bundle averages ~1KB/icon (slightly larger than lucide-react due to 6 weight variants: Thin/Light/Regular/Bold/Fill/Duotone).
